cards.name: Axis ACE

rules.desc: 5% cashback on utility bills, DTH and mobile recharges paid via Google Pay only; cap not stated on page
4% cashback on Swiggy, Zomato, Ola; cap not stated

cards.notes: Official ACE page: 5% GPay bills, 4% Swiggy/Zomato/Ola, 1.5% other. Official Apr 2024 T&C revision explicitly excludes 'purchase of jewelry items' and 'purchase of gold' from cashback. Fee 499 waived at Rs2L spend in anniversary year (MITC). Lounge needs Rs50k spend in prior 3 months (4 domestic/yr per third parties; not re-verified). Monthly cashback caps for 5%/4% categories not found. Old 2% figure (older aggregators) is obsolete; conflicts with ACE entry in cards.json (Gpay 5% only). Cashback is cash value (rate = Re1 per Re1). Effective 28 Aug 2026 (official notices summarised by third-party book1a.com): gift-card purchases and bridge/road/toll spends earn nothing; DCC markup 3.5% (forex 3.5% unchanged); late fee Rs1,300 at Rs50k+ outstanding. Fees exclude 18% GST. Point/mile value assumptions are estimates.

Tanishq vouchers are redeemable only via EDGE Rewards catalogue (points redemption, not a card discount). Kalyan voucher offer (Rs20k/month cap) found only in an undated document; not treated as current.

Jewellery offers listed are bank-wide (any Axis credit/debit card) and replicated per card; they expire 15 Oct 2026 (4 days after retrieval). 'value' for type percent is a fraction (0.20 = 20%). Visa/RuPay-specific jewellery offers (Giva Rs500 off Rs1,499 to 31 Dec 2026; Giva extra 25% RuPay to 31 Jul 2027) not included.
Official ACE T&C at axisbank.com redirects to a 404 on axis.bank.in; used the Apr 2024 ACE revision PDF and the MITC instead. Monthly caps for ACE 5%/4% categories not found.
Full per-card MITC reward tables not on official pages for Magnus (exact exclusions), Reserve (rates), Neo, Airtel, Cashback: jewellery treatment unverified for Neo, Airtel, Cashback.

Not covered: IndiGo Axis (BluChip value unknown; fee 799), IndiGo Premium, Vistara family, IndianOil, Samsung, Freecharge, Rewards, Pride, Buzz, Miles & More, SpiceJet, Burgundy Private, Kwik, Fibe, Google Pay Flex. MITC fee data exists for these.

EDGE point value (Rs0.20 portal/voucher; 0.5-1 via transfers) and EDGE Mile value (Re1 per Axis page) are estimates; true value depends on redemption. No official caps found for Atlas/Horizon travel earning besides Atlas Rs2L/month.
